quest.title: Scenes from Life in Meropide: Dead End
quest.description: Clynes is fixing something in the Rift of Erosion. If you help him, you should get compensated...
quest.rewards_formatted: Adventure EXP x200, Primogem x30, Mora x30000, Credit Coupons x280

response.speaker: Galvaryet
response.text: Why are you talking like Lanoire? Just get to the point.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: We need lots of Coupons. Are there any jobs we can take?

response.speaker: Galvaryet
response.text: You didn't join Estienne's game, did you? You should know when to stop.

response.speaker: Galvaryet
response.text: ...Nonetheless, there is something that I need your help with.

response.speaker: Galvaryet
response.text: Clynes should be repairing his device or whatever it is by the Rift of Erosion. Go help him out, would you?

response.speaker: Galvaryet
response.text: Just ask him for compensation. He won't object.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: We'll take care of it!

choices.text: Is there anything we can help with?

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: It would be better if there's compensation!

talks.objective: Find Clynes near the Rift of Erosion

dialogues.speaker: Clynes
dialogues.text: Just in time. Come help me out!

choices.text: You can read minds? That's scary!

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Galvaryet sent us to help you... But how did you know that?

response.speaker: Clynes
response.text: ...Because you're the only ones here to help.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: ...Well, that makes sense!

response.speaker: Clynes
response.text: Anyway, the task is nothing difficult. The Research Terminal here requires two people to operate it simultaneously, and I've already entered the commands. Just walk over and pull the lever.

response.speaker: Clynes
response.text: I almost forgot... The charging device should be nearby. Please install the charging device first before starting.

response.speaker: Clynes
response.text: And... Just to double-check, you're not machine killers, are you?

choices.text: It depends on how you define machine killers.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Why do you ask?

response.speaker: Clynes
response.text: I asked Galvana for help last time, and even though I only looked away for a moment, when I looked back, the terminal was already destroyed. I asked her what happened, but she couldn't tell me.

response.speaker: Clynes
response.text: I found out from her sister later that no machines can survive under her for more than half a day. Even Alain Guillotin would have given up on her, I suspect.

response.speaker: Clynes
response.text: Even the repair fee was deducted from my compensation. If you're just like her, then all my hard work will be in vain.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: What a story. We're definitely not like her. Don't worry!

response.speaker: Clynes
response.text: I'm counting on you, then.

choices.text: If the research terminal attacks me, then I guess I am.
We won't do this for free, though.

response.speaker: Clynes
response.text: I'll ask Galvaryet to apply for your payment later.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Huh? She said we can get compensation from you directly.

response.speaker: Clynes
response.text: Did she? Alright, then. Applying for funds here is even harder than from the Fontaine Research Institute...

dialogues.speaker: Clynes
dialogues.text: Is there something you don't understand? Just pull the lever along with me — very simple.

dialogues.speaker: Clynes
dialogues.text: Looking good. If we weren't in a place like this, I would have hired you as my assistants.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: This is too easy. By the way, what does this device do?

dialogues.speaker: Clynes
dialogues.text: There was a rift that connected to the outside, and it had to be watched. Now we can just seal the passage with this device and save manpower.

dialogues.speaker: Clynes
dialogues.text: This is nothing new to the Fontaine Research Institute, anyway. But since I have plenty of time, I modified it a little.

dialogues.speaker: Clynes
dialogues.text: What you're seeing now isn't even its final form, which was actually deployed at the Geode Mine Shaft... Ahem, I think I spoke too much. Just pretend you didn't hear anything.

choices.text: So, there are exits in the Geode Mine Shaft.

response.speaker: Clynes
response.text: Right, you're a smart one. But if you were smarter, you would have kept that to yourself and not blurted it out.

response.speaker: Clynes
response.text: Anyway, problem solved. Galvana no longer needs to come down too often, and I can take a break.

response.speaker: Clynes
response.text: ...Ah, yes. I almost forgot about your compensation. Thanks for the help!

choices.text: Is the final version more powerful?

response.speaker: Clynes
response.text: Of course! There are other components... Wait, why do you want to know?

response.speaker: Clynes
response.text: If you want to know the full extent of it, you can give it a try yourself. But if you're caught, don't say I put you up to it.
